name: Spending insights
author: ptbudget
description: Read-only summaries of spending by category, merchant and month.

tools.name: spend_by_category
tools.description: Total spending per category between two dates (inclusive, YYYY-MM-DD). Expenses are returned as positive amounts.
tools.sql: SELECT COALESCE(c.name, 'Uncategorized') AS category, COUNT(*) AS transactions, ROUND(SUM(-t.amount), 2) AS spent FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN categories c ON c.id = t.category_id WHERE t.type = 'expense' AND t.is_excluded = 0 AND t.date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate GROUP BY category ORDER BY spent DESC

tools.name: top_merchants
tools.description: Merchants (companies, or raw descriptions when unmatched) ranked by total spend between two dates.
tools.sql: SELECT COALESCE(comp.name, t.description) AS merchant, COUNT(*) AS transactions, ROUND(SUM(-t.amount), 2) AS spent FROM transactions t LEFT JOIN companies comp ON comp.id = t.company_id WHERE t.type = 'expense' AND t.is_excluded = 0 AND t.date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate GROUP BY merchant ORDER BY spent DESC LIMIT COALESCE(:limit, 10)

tools.name: monthly_totals
tools.description: Income and expense totals per month (YYYY-MM) for the last N months.

months.description: How many months back to include (default 6).

tools.sql: SELECT substr(t.date, 1, 7) AS month, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'income' THEN t.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS income, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'expense' THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS expenses FROM transactions t WHERE t.is_excluded = 0 AND t.date >= date('now', 'start of month', '-' || (COALESCE(:months, 6) - 1) || ' months') GROUP BY month ORDER BY month DESC
